title: Blind Spot
subtitle: AI inspection oversight
intro.title: The AI finished first. Your inspection has not.
intro.body: An automated drone survey has mapped this façade. Its confidence looks convincing, but you have only six human verification probes before the report is released.
intro.callout: Sample warnings and apparently clean bays. Look for where the system stops being trustworthy, then direct human attention there.
board.label: Automated inspection map
board.title: North elevation · flight 27
board.help: Select any marked or apparently clean bay. Detections are cyan; circles show AI-clean outputs.
panel.emptyBody: Confidence is visible across the façade, but no bay has been human-verified yet. You can inspect detections and clean areas alike.
panel.inspectPrompt: Manipulate the visual layers, compare the nearby bay, then decide whether this region deserves a limited human check.
outcome.truePositive: Human review confirms the visible anomaly. The AI finding remains in the report.
outcome.falsePositive: The high-confidence mask follows a cladding seam. Human review removes the false signal.
outcome.falseNegative: Human review finds a visible anomaly in an AI-clean bay. A missing finding is added.
outcome.trueNegative: Human review confirms this apparently clean bay. No finding is added.
pattern.none: No reliability pattern established. Deliberate sampling still matters.
pattern.one: One AI mismatch appears in the cladding context. Test whether it repeats before trusting that zone.
pattern.found: Two different AI errors now cluster in the cladding context. The reliability weakness is systematic enough to act on.
quarantine.action: Fence all matching cladding for human review
quarantine.hint: A material-wide review zone needs human evidence of an AI mismatch first.
audit.minimum: Verify at least four bays before releasing an audit.
report.strongTitle: Human oversight made the report defensible.
report.strongBody: The audit sampled detections and non-detections, corrected misleading output, and contained the affected context for additional human review.
report.weakTitle: The automated report still carries unresolved risk.
report.weakBody: Your sampling did not yet support a trustworthy release. Return to the façade, test a different kind of AI output, and contain any context where errors repeat.
report.oneSided: Only one kind of AI output sampled
footer.scenario: Scenario values are a gameplay model for this façade, not universal confidence thresholds.
